commonPromptSpecification: Photoreal model-specific standalone component; true transparent alpha; neutral studio light; no packaging, UI, white background or unrelated hardware; full outline in frame. Near side-panel camera, rear left/front right; motherboards face viewer, GPUs horizontal with fans downward, DIMMs vertical, M.2 horizontal. Case assets are empty open-side chassis. Images are labeled concepts rather than verified photography.
